The '''2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Florida]] in the sport of [[college basketball|basketball]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was the Gators' first season since 1995-96 without long-time head coach [[Billy Donovan]], as he left the Gators to become the new head coach of the [[NBA]]'s [[Oklahoma City Thunder]]. The Gators, led by first year head coach [[Mike White (basketball)|Mike White]], competed in the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) and played their home games in the [[O'Connell Center]] on the university's [[Gainesville, Florida]] campus. They finished the season 21–15, 9–9 in [[2015–16 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for eighth place. They lost to [[2015–16 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they defeated [[2015–16 North Florida Ospreys men's basketball team|North Florida]], 97–68, and [[2015–16 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]], 74–66, to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to  [[2015–16 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|George Washington]], 82–77.

==Previous season==
The [[2014–15 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Gators]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 16–17, 8–10 in [[2014–15 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for eighth place. They advanced to the quarterfinals of the [[2015 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] where they lost to Kentucky. They did not participate in a postseason tournament for the first time in 17 years.
